verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat is an AI assistant that could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Otter running its own MCP server, which exposes meeting data to Claude and ChatGPT. That is the opposite role and earns no credit here. Its connected-app integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, documents) are first-party connectors, not user-pluggable MCP servers, and nothing shows Otter consuming external MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
